title: edit.BlockList drops block entries that follow a flow list in a dsh patch list
head: 92b3d82cf78b1b2ff93ffc07d83c999c2784a5f2
testCommands: go vet ./... ; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go vet -tags nogui ./... ; GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go vet ./...
go build ./... ; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./... ; GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...
testsAdded:
TestBlockList's refusal list now holds the issue's four inputs: "[]
- id: a
", "[ {id: x} ]
- id: a
", "--- []
- id: a
" and "--- [ {id: x} ]
- id: a
" - each taken as a flow list before, so only the sequence survived.
unverifiedBoundaries: No real dsh run: the contract is BlockList's, and both callers (dshParse, dshRead) leave a file that BlockList refuses as it was.

A file with block content after the flow list is refused rather than repaired, which is what the issue asked for; a multi-line flow sequence with a comment inside it is still accepted (the scanner stops at the matching bracket).
preExistingRed: internal/edit TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink is red with this machine's umask 0027 and equally red on the clean base (evidence/2674/base-hardlink.log); it is #3640's report.
